original.text: prasanne ca gurau bhūte pūrṇācāryābhiṣekataḥ | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā siddhibhāgī bhaviṣyati ||
original.edition: Bodhipathapradīpa, GRETIL/DSBC e-text (Sanskrit reconstruction) (IAST by the unit)
original.licence: GRETIL/DSBC e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: If one wishes to complete the accumulations for awakening easily by the powers of mantra — pacifying, increasing and the rest — and the eight great attainments such as the good vase, the secret conduct taught in the kriyā, caryā and other tantras is desired; then, for the master's consecration, please the true guru by gifts of jewels and by obeying all commands; when the guru is pleased, by the complete master's consecration one is purified of all evil and becomes fit for attainments.
notes: Restored Sanskrit (L. N. Shastri 1984), reconstructed from the Tibetan; quote is v. 64 only.

original.text: ādibuddhamahātantre prayatnena niṣedhataḥ | guhyaprajñābhiṣekastu na grahyā brahmacārariṇā || so 'bhiṣeko gṛhītaścet brahyacaryatapaḥ sthitaiḥ | niṣiddhācaraṇatvāt tattapaḥ samvarakṣayaḥ ||
original.edition: Bodhipathapradīpa, GRETIL/DSBC e-text (Sanskrit reconstruction) (IAST by the unit)
original.licence: GRETIL/DSBC e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: Because it is strictly forbidden in the great Ādibuddha tantra, the secret and wisdom consecrations are not to be taken by one who keeps celibacy; if those established in celibate austerity take that consecration, doing what is forbidden, their austerity and vows are destroyed; the pārājika downfalls arise for that vow-holder, he surely falls into the bad destinies and never gains attainment.
notes: Restored Sanskrit, reconstructed from the Tibetan. The 'Ādibuddha tantra' is the Kālacakra root tantra in the tradition's reading.

original.text: sarvatantraśrutau bhāṣye homayajñādikarmāsu | labdhācāryābhiṣekaśca tattvavida naiva duṣyati ||
original.edition: Bodhipathapradīpa, GRETIL/DSBC e-text (Sanskrit reconstruction) (IAST by the unit)
original.licence: GRETIL/DSBC e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: One who has received the master's consecration and knows reality commits no fault in hearing and explaining all the tantras and in fire offerings, sacrifices and the like.
